clear-body.shortEffect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.
clear-body.effect: This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle.
clear-body.flavor: Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

light-metal.effect: This Pokémon has half the usual weight for its species.

steel-beam.shortEffect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
steel-beam.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.
